Its full occupancies, density (~2.90 g cm^-3), and tetrahedral Li-O, Fe-O, and Si-O distances are physically plausible. Although no independent comparable-Rwp score was supplied, the near-noise whole-pattern fit, weak-line confirmation, chemical plausibility, and resolved discrete ordering leave no materially different scientifically motivated candidate likely to improve the submitted set.
